name: Hints of a New Plague?
summary: In Hillsbrad, Phin Odelic's companions search for signs of trouble. Quae and Kinelory have been missing for days since heading to Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: Odd Happenings
sections.body: Phin Odelic's cousin in Hillsbrad had to put down his dog, Stanley. The beast had mystically grown huge and savagely attacked anyone who came near. Phin believes the undead are involved in these odd happenings, and his band searches for signs to prove it.

sections.title: The Missing Companions
sections.body: Quae and Kinelory, Phin Odelic's companions, headed to Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. They have not checked in for days, and Phin fears for them. He wants you to find them near the farm.

aliases: who gives hints of a new plague
faq.answer: Phin Odelic leads a band of adventurers investigating odd happenings in the area.
Stanley was Phin's cousin's dog in Hillsbrad. The beast mystically grew huge and attacked anyone who came near, so the cousin put him down.

faq.q: Where are Quae and Kinelory supposed to be?
faq.answer: Quae and Kinelory set out for Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. Phin has heard nothing from them for days.
Phin believes the undead are involved in the odd happenings, and his band searches for signs to prove it.
